profile.method: outer: entry/kernel/callback and WFI. panel: add two adjacent panel intervals. tile: additionally time all 51 five-row tiles and the last one-row tile per panel. Critical fields select the callback finishing last on each run; their raw ticks partition the kernel interval. Per-core tails and main WFI overlap this time. Tile arithmetic includes accumulator initialization, Q/K loads and loop overhead. These are elapsed guest timestamps, not pure FMA cycles or host CPU time.

wfi.method: The real worker idle, dispatcher ready and dispatcher join WFI sites are bracketed by fenced guest rdtime. Intervals include small logging/host-scheduling overhead, not pure hardware sleep or host blocked time. Clip each to actual dispatch and pre/post callback windows; open events persist through the end of any intersecting dispatch. No inner K instrumentation. Work and WFI of distinct cores may overlap.

plain_batches.metric: median forward_s: QEMU start to UART; no guest instrumentation
median forward_s: QEMU start to UART; no guest instrumentation

arithmetic_audit.method: Native C fmaf in K order (RNE); compare every new acc bit pattern with its predecessor; final add +0. Counts only, not timed.

decision: No arithmetic or scheduling change adopted. No measured evidence of 28 ms of removable work with ordered FP32 FMA and all score outputs. Per-core WFI overlaps computation. Per-tile time includes guest loads, loop control and host scheduling.
